title: "Read Distribution"
output: html_document
---

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(taxizedb)
library(gt)
library(here)
library(pavian)
library(pctax)
library(pcutils)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

# Read distribution of the PacBio HIFI reads

```{r echo=FALSE}
# child ids under oomycota: 4762
child.id <- c(taxizedb::downstream(4762)$`4762`$childtaxa_id, '4762')
files <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/Kraken2/raw',
                    full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = '.kraken$')
df <- map_dfr(files, function(file) {
  data <- fread(file, drop = 5, showProgress = FALSE)
  colnames(data) <- c('status', 'id', 'tax', 'length')
  data <- data %>% mutate(file = str_remove(basename(file), '.fastq.gz.kraken'))
}) %>% mutate(is.oomycota = (tax %in% child.id))

ggplot(df) +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = length, fill = is.oomycota), binwidth = 1000) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  facet_wrap(~file, ncol = 1, scales = 'free_y')
```

# Taxonomy abundance of PacBio raw reads

```{r}
files <- list.files('~/project_data/downy/Kraken2/raw',
                    full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = '.kreport$')
df.rpt <- map_dfr(files, function(file) {
  read_report2(file, add_taxRank_columns = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(file = str_remove(basename(file), '.fastq.gz.kreport'))})
```

Is there any interesting species other than oomycota?

```{r}
df.rpt %>% 
  filter(taxRank %in% c('U', 'S'), P != 'p_Oomycota') %>% 
  select(percentage, P, S, file) %>% 
  group_by(file) %>% 
  slice_max(order_by = percentage, n = 30) %>% 
  split(.$file)
```
